stylePrefix: Minimalist editorial illustration on a warm parchment paper background (hex #f6f1e8), precise black ink linework and flat geometric shapes, exactly one terracotta (hex #c94f2e) accent element, constructivist print aesthetic, subtle paper grain texture, generous negative space, no gradients, no photo-realism, absolutely no text, letters, numbers, words or logos.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : flux entrants convergeant vers un point d'ancrage terracotta, symbole d'acquisition de clients.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: inbound flows converging toward a terracotta anchor point, a symbol of client acquisition.

images.prompt: Subject: a field of thin ink arrows and dotted flow lines entering from the left edge and converging toward a single bold terracotta circle on the right third, evoking inbound growth and client acquisition, a few small hollow circles scattered along the flows.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : tableau de bord abstrait fait de jauges et de courbes à l'encre, un curseur terracotta marquant le cap.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: abstract dashboard of ink gauges and curves, a terracotta cursor marking the course.

images.prompt: Subject: an abstract instrument panel composed of thin ink line charts, semicircular gauges and small bar columns arranged on an invisible grid, one terracotta needle or cursor highlighting a single gauge, evoking steering and measurement.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : engrenages et convoyeurs schématiques à l'encre, une dent d'engrenage terracotta, symbole d'opérations fluides.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: schematic ink gears and conveyors, one terracotta gear tooth, a symbol of smooth operations.

images.prompt: Subject: interlocking schematic gears drawn with thin ink outlines connected by straight conveyor lines and small rollers, one gear filled in solid terracotta, evoking frictionless operations and process machinery.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : trois usines schématiques reliées par des flux, quatre nœuds de blocage cerclés, le principal en terracotta.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: three schematic factories linked by flows, four circled bottleneck nodes, the main one in terracotta.

images.prompt: Subject: three small schematic factory buildings with sawtooth roofs drawn in thin ink outline, connected by straight and dotted flow lines, four junction nodes circled along the flows, one node marked with a solid terracotta circle, evoking an inter-site bottleneck audit in manufacturing.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : pile de documents stylisés produits en chaîne par un mécanisme à l'encre, un document terracotta mis en avant.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: stack of stylized documents produced in sequence by an ink mechanism, one terracotta document highlighted.

images.prompt: Subject: a row of overlapping blank document sheets drawn as simple ink rectangles with folded corners, flowing out of a small abstract machine made of lines and circles, one sheet filled in solid terracotta, evoking automated document production for a consulting firm.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : calendrier abstrait et courbe de clôture à l'encre, deux cases barrées et un point terracotta, symbole de clôture mensuelle accélérée.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: abstract ink calendar and closing curve, two crossed-out cells and a terracotta dot, a symbol of a faster monthly close.

images.prompt: Subject: an abstract monthly calendar grid of empty ink squares beside a descending step-line curve, two grid cells crossed out with thin diagonal strokes, one terracotta dot placed at the end of the curve, evoking a shortened monthly financial close for an asset management firm.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : entonnoir de pipeline à l'encre dont les fuites sont recousues, goutte terracotta récupérée en sortie.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: ink pipeline funnel with its leaks stitched back, a terracotta drop recovered at the outlet.

images.prompt: Subject: a large funnel drawn in thin ink outline with small leak lines on its sides being closed by tiny stitch marks, orderly drops flowing through, the final drop at the funnel outlet filled in solid terracotta, evoking a B2B SaaS revenue pipeline recovered and cleaned.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : aimant stylisé à l'encre attirant une constellation de points, le point capté en terracotta.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: stylized ink magnet attracting a constellation of dots, the captured dot in terracotta.

images.prompt: Subject: a simple horseshoe magnet drawn in thin ink outline at the bottom, a loose constellation of small hollow dots above being pulled along curved field lines, the closest dot filled in solid terracotta, evoking lead acquisition.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : page stylisée rayonnante avec lignes de lecture à l'encre, balise terracotta unique.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: stylized radiant page with ink reading lines, a single terracotta marker.

images.prompt: Subject: a single large page rectangle with abstract horizontal reading bars of varying lengths, thin rays emanating outward from the page like a print sunburst, one small terracotta bookmark shape clipped to the page edge, evoking content and search visibility.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : bulles de dialogue géométriques à l'encre triées en file ordonnée, une bulle terracotta résolue.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: geometric ink speech bubbles sorted into an orderly queue, one resolved terracotta bubble.

images.prompt: Subject: several geometric speech bubble shapes of different sizes drawn in thin ink outline, arranged from a scattered cluster on the left into a neat aligned row on the right, the leading bubble filled in solid terracotta, evoking automated customer support triage.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : balance et colonnes comptables abstraites à l'encre, fléau souligné d'un trait terracotta.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: abstract ink balance scale and ledger columns, the beam underlined with a terracotta stroke.

images.prompt: Subject: a minimal balance scale drawn with thin ink lines standing over a few abstract ledger columns made of short horizontal bars, perfectly level beam underlined by a single solid terracotta stroke, evoking finance operations brought to equilibrium.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : silhouette d'usine en toit de sheds à l'encre, fumée géométrique, cheminée ponctuée de terracotta.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: ink factory silhouette with sawtooth roof, geometric smoke, chimney dotted with terracotta.

images.prompt: Subject: a single factory silhouette with a sawtooth shed roof drawn in thin ink outline, geometric circles of stylized smoke above one chimney, the topmost smoke circle filled in solid terracotta, evoking modernized industry.

alt.fr: Illustration éditoriale : cadran d'horloge épuré à l'encre dont un secteur libéré est rempli de terracotta.
alt.en: Editorial illustration: clean ink clock face with one freed sector filled in terracotta.

images.prompt: Subject: a large minimal clock face drawn with thin ink ticks and two slender hands, one pie sector of the dial filled in solid terracotta as recovered time, a few small task squares dissolving away at the edge, evoking productivity and hours saved.

alt.fr: Texture de fond discrète : trame de points d'encre espacés sur papier parchemin.
alt.en: Subtle background texture: sparse ink dot screen on parchment paper.

images.prompt: Subject: an extremely subtle and sparse halftone dot screen of tiny black ink dots evenly spaced on the parchment background, dots fading toward the center to leave it almost empty, no accent color at all, designed as a quiet section background.

alt.fr: Texture de fond discrète : fine grille technique à l'encre, presque effacée, sur papier parchemin.
alt.en: Subtle background texture: faint technical ink grid, almost erased, on parchment paper.

images.prompt: Subject: a very faint blueprint-like grid of hairline ink rules on the parchment background, a few slightly heavier lines forming an off-center margin like a print layout guide, extremely low contrast, no accent color, designed as a quiet section background.

alt.fr: Texture de fond discrète : courbes topographiques à l'encre très claires sur papier parchemin, un point terracotta minuscule.
alt.en: Subtle background texture: very light ink contour lines on parchment paper, one tiny terracotta dot.

images.prompt: Subject: very light concentric topographic contour lines drawn with hairline ink strokes drifting across the parchment background, mostly empty space, one tiny terracotta dot at the center of the innermost contour, extremely low contrast, designed as a quiet section background.
